_doc: Synergies unlock when the player's owned abilities (and weapons, via weapon_tags) carry at least the listed count of each tag. Bespoke effects are code keyed by id (autoload/abilities.gd etc.); data-driven ones use hit_status {tags_any, status}, hit_amp {tags_any, amount, vs_status?, vs_elite?}, on_hit / on_kill {tags_any, effects}. tags_any empty = every ability hit.

synergies.name: Explosive Miasma
synergies.desc: Foes both Burning and Plagued explode on death, spreading fire and plague.

synergies.name: Firestorm
synergies.desc: Lightning ignites what it strikes. Burning foes take +30% storm damage.

synergies.name: Sanguine Legion
synergies.desc: Your summons deal +40% damage and every kill they make heals you 1 HP.

synergies.name: Assassin's Mark
synergies.desc: Hits against Cursed foes have +25% chance to critically strike for double damage.

synergies.name: Magma Forge
synergies.desc: Brute abilities leave pools of magma where they land.

synergies.name: Soul Cage
synergies.desc: Kills grant an extra Soul. Summons grow 0.3% stronger per Soul held.

synergies.name: Contagion
synergies.desc: Plague ticks also Curse. Plague spreads to 2 more foes on death.

synergies.name: Conductive Chains
synergies.desc: Lightning jumps +2 times and briefly Binds. Bound foes take +25% storm damage.

synergies.name: Boiling Blood
synergies.desc: Whenever you spend life, a burst of hellfire erupts around you.

synergies.name: Wrecking Ball
synergies.desc: Hooked and Bound foes take +40% damage from brute and melee attacks; hooks land with a shockwave.

synergies.name: Static Step
synergies.desc: Blinking or slaying a Shocked foe discharges chain lightning.

synergies.name: Soul Transfusion
synergies.desc: Each Soul gained heals 0.5 HP. Blood abilities cost 40% less life.

synergies.name: Plague Bearers
synergies.desc: Your summons Plague what they strike and burst into a pestilent cloud when they expire.

synergies.name: Shackled Damnation
synergies.desc: Bound foes count as having 3 extra Curse stacks.

synergies.name: Hellstorm Trinity
synergies.desc: All ability cooldowns -15%. Ability damage +15%.

synergies.name: Lord of the Pit
synergies.desc: Summon limits +2. A fallen angel sometimes rises as your thrall (8%).

synergies.name: Crimson Pact
synergies.desc: Bleeding foes take damage 40% faster. You heal 0.2 HP whenever a Bleeding foe dies.

synergies.name: Blood Fury
synergies.desc: Life you spend on blood magic feeds your Wrath twice over.

synergies.name: Unstoppable
synergies.desc: Each Wrath stack grants +0.06 Armor.

synergies.name: Soul Market
synergies.desc: Greed also counts half your reaped Souls as Ichor.

synergies.name: Coin-Op Hell
synergies.desc: Kills by machines spill Ichor (25%). Machines hit Gilded foes 20% harder.

synergies.name: Stolen Thunder
synergies.desc: Envy hits have a 50% chance to arc lightning to 2 more foes.

synergies.name: Covetous Curse
synergies.desc: Envy hits lay 2 Curse stacks.

synergies.name: Regicide
synergies.desc: Abilities deal +35% damage to elites and bosses.

synergies.name: Sunfall
synergies.desc: Pride strikes leave a crater of burning ground.

synergies.name: Rotten Feast
synergies.desc: Anything Gluttony kills bursts in a cloud of rot (Plague).

synergies.name: Bone Banquet
synergies.desc: Half of what Gluttony kills rises again as your thrall.

synergies.name: Smoke and Mirrors
synergies.desc: Every blink leaves a mirror decoy where you stood. Illusion hits +20% damage.

synergies.name: False Idols
synergies.desc: Illusion hits Curse twice and slow.

synergies.name: Hellforge
synergies.desc: Machine hits Burn twice and deal +15% damage.

synergies.name: Tripwire
synergies.desc: Mines and traps Bind what they hit.

synergies.name: Lash of Gehenna
synergies.desc: Whip hits Burn twice and deal +20% damage.

synergies.name: Chain Dancer
synergies.desc: Whips reach 30% further and hit Bound foes 30% harder.

synergies.name: Flagellant
synergies.desc: Whip hits cause Bleeding; 30% of them heal you 0.4 HP.

synergies.name: The Seven Deadly
synergies.desc: Five sins as one: every ability deals +30% damage.
